data.narrative:
Ocius Technology, a Series B defense and security company founded by Robert Dane, has secured A$176M in Program of Record funding as of March 2026. The valuation analysis incorporates a peer set of 10 comparable companies across Defense & Security at similar stages: 2 public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $176M total raised as a proxy base and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, yields $334M. Peer-median methodology across 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables produces $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). The peer cohort demonstrates substantial valuation dispersion, reflecting heterogeneity in execution and market perception within the defense-tech segment.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $284M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median point estimate of $730M. The 4.6x spread between low and high anchors reflects meaningful uncertainty around growth trajectory, contract conversion risk, and the comparable companies' valuation sustainability. Stage-progression implies a more conservative outcome, while peer-median suggests upside potential contingent on Ocius demonstrating execution momentum equivalent to the higher-valued peers in the set.
